### Seeking Solitude with the Savior - The Crosswalk Devotional - March 11
Author: Rev. Kyle Norman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/seeking-solitude-with-the-savior-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Mark 1:35
Points:
- Spiritual vitality is not measured by relentless activity or efficiency.
- Jesus deliberately withdrew to quiet, empty places to disconnect from earthly demands.
- Time in solitude provided Christ with clarity and guidance for His mission.
- Stepping away to pray grants believers peace and direction amid crowded schedules.
- Setting aside even brief, quiet moments each day deepens our communion with God.

### Day 114: Mark 1:35
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-114-mark-1-35.html
Passage: Mark 1:35
Points:
- After a demanding evening ministering to people, Jesus rose before dawn to pray.
- Christ's private prayer time reflects the intimate fellowship between Father and Son.
- Living in human flesh meant navigating physical limits and competing demands from others.
- Jesus resisted the urgent pull of the crowds to keep preaching the kingdom as His primary goal.
